primary_product_story: Ontology of Continua System Architect Workbench

personas.opening_question: Can this help me understand and harden a real system?
personas.success_signal: Completes diagnose -> kill -> improve -> compare -> export without reading source files.

personas.opening_question: Why should I believe this is more than a visualization?
personas.success_signal: Every claim routes to proof, boundary, source hash, formula and graph context.

personas.opening_question: Where is my domain and what recognizable anchors are here?
personas.success_signal: Domain lane opens replay-backed or boundary-marked examples with exportable assumptions.

personas.opening_question: What is OC and what can I click first?
personas.success_signal: The cockpit provides a live model, a kill action, a ladder and cross-links.

personas.opening_question: What practical work does this improve?
personas.success_signal: Mission deck produces before/after diagnostics and a reviewer export.

acceptance_contract.first_screen: Shows Version 010, a live workbench model and the diagnose/kill/improve/compare/export route.
acceptance_contract.no_text_only_answers: Reviewer objections resolve to functional routes and clicked surfaces.
acceptance_contract.truth_discipline: Unsupported science is shown as boundary or formalization obligation, never as proof.
